text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of girls enrolled in lower secondary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for girls in lower secondary education. Net enrollment shows the
share of girls of lower secondary school age (typically 12–14 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment
includes all girls regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of girls of the same age group.
